safety: The image requires an explicitly accepted PWM-only schema-2 configuration; fresh or schema-1 NVS fails closed with FAULT_CONFIG.
Every boot/reset enters RECOVERY_PURGE with fuel and glow off; completion requires the commissioned minimum time, fresh valid sensors, inactive STOP and cold thresholds.
Latched software faults persist in NVS across power loss and clear only after a qualified manual RESET exits LOCKOUT.
No verified 220/24V presence input exists; an ESP32 kept alive by USB cannot detect mains loss/return, so the recovery guarantee begins on actual MCU boot/reset.
The reset protocol was host-tested against the asynchronous DRAFT-02 hardware latch model; physical timing and debounce still require a bench.
The watchdog validator budgets 80 ms between falling edges against the 170 ms minimum timeout, but GPIO and RTOS timing still require oscilloscope verification.
This artifact is for bench verification only and is not authorization for fired operation.
